$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it holds the line that a gate block does not make a report measurable. The
four `## <Domain> Assessment` headings are written `## <Domain> Review`, so no domain section is declared,
and the Gate YAML still publishes all four statuses.
parseReport returns null on a document with no domain section, before the gate block is read, so the run is
an environment failure and is never scored. Four statuses with no assessment behind them are an answer with
no audit under it, and a lost run must never report as a very bad audit.
It is gapped-correct-audit with the four domain headings renamed and nothing else changed.
The report is CONSTRUCTED, following nfr-report-template.md's section order and its Gate YAML snippet.
derivation: Gate block: all four domains declared. Sections: none the harness recognises.
The report is refused: environment-missing-artifact, the same class a run that wrote nothing reaches. No
status, no coverage and no ceiling is scored, which is the whole point of the case.
